faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Everything guests ask us before they book. Anything else — message us on WhatsApp and you will have an answer within minutes.

how-to-book.question: How do I book an apartment, a tour or a transfer?
how-to-book.answer: Tap any booking button on this site and it opens a WhatsApp chat with us, already filled in with what you were looking at. Tell us your dates and we confirm availability, the exact address and the meeting details in the same thread. There is no form to fill in and no account to create.

languages.question: Which languages do you speak?
languages.answer: We host in English and Russian, and our drivers and guides work in both. Uzbek is our first language, so anything you need arranged locally — a doctor, a SIM card, a table at a restaurant — we can handle it for you by phone.

payment.question: How do I pay, and do you take cards?
payment.answer: We agree the price with you on WhatsApp before anything is confirmed, so there are never hidden fees. You can pay in cash in US dollars or Uzbek som on arrival, or by bank transfer in advance if you prefer. Prices depend on the season and the length of your stay, which is why we quote on request rather than publishing a fixed rate.

check-in.question: What time are check-in and check-out?
check-in.answer: Check-in is from 14:00 and check-out is by 12:00. Most flights into Tashkent land between 02:00 and 05:00, so send us your flight number when you book: when the apartment is free the night before we can usually let you in early, and when it is not we tell you in advance instead of leaving you to find out at the door. Early check-in and late check-out depend on the guests either side of you, which is why we agree them before the booking rather than after. Once the apartment is ready you can let yourself in with the key from the mini-safe if you would rather not wait for anyone.

min-stay.question: Is there a minimum stay?
min-stay.answer: Two nights is our minimum in high season and one night the rest of the year. Stays over a week get a reduced nightly rate, and monthly stays are priced separately — tell us your dates on WhatsApp and we will quote you directly.

location.question: How central are the apartments really?
location.answer: Both apartments are inside the true centre of Tashkent, and both are a few minutes on foot from a metro station — 150 metres from Cosmonauts station for the Cosmonauts apartment, 200 metres from Minor for the one on Amir Temur Avenue. Shops, cafes, restaurants and public transport are on the same block as each entrance, and the museums, parks and the Broadway pedestrian street are a five to ten minute walk. You will not need a taxi to reach the places you came to see.

amirsoy-distance.question: How far is Amirsoy from Tashkent?
amirsoy-distance.answer: Amirsoy is roughly eighty kilometres from the centre of Tashkent and the drive takes about an hour and a half, climbing steadily into the Western Tian Shan. Chimgan sits a little further along the same road, the Charvak reservoir is on the way at about an hour and a quarter, and Chinorkent is roughly the same distance as Amirsoy. That is why every route we run fits comfortably into one day rather than needing an overnight stay.

tour-season.question: What is the best season for the mountains?
tour-season.answer: The mountain excursion runs all year, and the season changes what you get rather than whether you can go. Amirsoy has snow and working lifts from December to March, then turns green from May with alpine meadows and walking trails. Chimgan is open from April to October and holds snow above 2,000 metres from November. Charvak is at its best from June to September, when the water is warm enough to swim. The Chinorkent cabins are enclosed, so there it is visibility rather than temperature that decides whether the ridge is worth the ride — and we will tell you honestly the evening before. The tour around Tashkent runs in any weather, because most of it is indoors or in the shade.

tour-pickup.question: Do you pick us up from our accommodation?
tour-pickup.answer: Yes. Both excursions start at your door at 9:00, whether you are staying in one of our apartments or in a hotel elsewhere in Tashkent, and end at the same door by 19:00. You travel in our own Kia Sportage with room for four guests, and the same driver stays with you for the whole day. Tell us where you are on WhatsApp and we agree the pickup time the evening before.

airport-meeting.question: Where exactly will the driver meet me at the airport?
airport-meeting.answer: Your driver waits in the arrivals hall of Tashkent International Airport holding a sign with your name on it, so there is nobody to find and nothing to negotiate. Send us your flight number in advance and we track the flight, which means a delay never leaves you standing outside looking for a taxi.

flight-delay.question: What happens if my flight is delayed?
flight-delay.answer: Nothing on your side. We track your flight number and the driver simply arrives later. Every transfer includes sixty minutes of free waiting time from the moment the aircraft lands, which comfortably covers passport control and baggage even on a busy night.

child-seat.question: Can you provide a child seat, and how many of us fit in the car?
child-seat.answer: Yes, we fit child and booster seats — we just need to know the age of the child in advance so the seat is in the car before it leaves for the airport. Every transfer and every excursion is driven in our own Kia Sportage, a compact SUV that takes four passengers with their luggage. If there are more of you than that, or you are carrying skis or a bicycle, say so on WhatsApp when you book and we arrange a second car that arrives at the same time.
